verdict.rationale: Apple's own Mac Help guide includes a "Run Windows on your Mac" entry, so running Windows is a documented topic. The evidence does not say whether this means a virtual machine, dual-booting, or a third-party tool, and it gives no detail on how full the environment is. missing for 10: explicit evidence of a virtual machine, any detail on the Windows environment's completeness or app compatibility, independent or hands-on corroboration.
